_about: Public-domain William Fraser McDowell (1858-1937), bishop of the Methodist Episcopal Church, for the Word Hoard: his books printed before 1930: In the School of Christ (1910), A Man's Religion (1913), Good Ministers of Jesus Christ, the Yale Lyman Beecher lectures (1917), This Mind (1922), Making a Personal Faith (1924), That I May Save Some (1928) and Them He Also Called (1929). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 79 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

mcdowell-school-of-christ: In the school of Christ (New York : Revell, 1910)
